capabilities: Capture memos from an input card, global hotkey or iOS Shortcut
Store memos as timestamped entries in daily YYYY.md files
Browse a reverse-chronological waterfall feed with pinned and starred views
Search memos by tags and keywords
Report activity with heatmaps, tag rankings and yearly calendars
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or memory-training tool; it is a quick-capture memo feed.
extras: Manual installation only (or via BRAT); interface available in Chinese and English; soft-deleted memos go to _trash.md; iOS Shortcut capture accepts text only, not images.
motivation: The author wanted a place to jot down stray thoughts without backlinks, knowledge graphs or folder decisions, while keeping every memo as a plain Markdown file that can be grepped anytime.
problem: Quick stray thoughts are awkward to capture in Obsidian's folder-and-link model, and hosted memo apps keep them out of the user's own plain-text files.

relations.evidence: A flomo-style fleeting-thoughts plugin for Obsidian
Memoria can receive text from an iOS Shortcut and save it as a memo at the current time

summary: Flomo-style memo plugin that captures timestamped thoughts into daily YYYY.md files and shows them in a waterfall feed with heatmaps and stats.
